name: Wish

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Copy any spell of level 8 or lower without components, or ask for something greater at the risk of losing Wish.
text: Set uses include creating a nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 GP, fully healing up to twenty creatures, granting up to ten creatures a permanent Resistance or 8 hours of immunity to one spell, swapping one of your feats, or forcing a reroll of any die rolled in the last round. Any use other than copying a spell leaves you taking 1d10 Necrotic damage per spell level for each spell you cast until a Long Rest, with Strength 3 for 2d4 days and a 33 percent chance of never casting Wish again.
